description: S462 review regression pin. A handler whose statement is an if/else with a TEMPLATE-LITERAL cell read in a branch (`@s = `x ${@n}``) — braced and braceless arms, `{…}` and `${…}` handler forms, and a multi-line value with a trailing newline — compiles and runs the right branch; plus a `;`-sequence handler with a template cell read (button 6, failing on base). The S462 if/else reroute put these on the handler statement path, whose client template literals shipped a bare `@n` (E-CODEGEN-INVALID-LOGIC); the client emitter now lowers a template interior that reads a cell. Condition = false.
rationale: §5.2.3: an inline block's statements SHALL run; a template literal's `${@cell}` is a cell read in every logic position.
